title: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery

title: Click, Strip, Repeat: Sex Workers and Digital Violence Amidst the Deepfake Boom
text: For victims of targeted, sexualized attacks, searching for redress is not easy: they are blamed for posting pictures of them online, accused of overreacting by the police, and followed for life with the consequences of losing the control over their own body and image.
